courses.title: Yoga: private or group sessions
courses.description: Fifty-five-minute yoga sessions with Devarshi, one-to-one or for a small group, arranged directly with him. He has taught yoga since the 1970s and led the Kripalu School of Yoga for ten years.

flags: The original plan left out 'Private Yoga Therapy sessions' for therapy framing. His sessions page now lists only 'Yoga - Private or Group, 55 Minutes | $85' with no therapy or health wording, so that is what is restored. Its own sub-page (stevenhartman.com/yoga-private-or-group) has no text, so the item links to the sessions page, which no other item uses. The description is thin because the page says little; a human may want to look.
Bodywork sessions on the same page (deep tissue, Reiki, Holotropic Breathwork) were not in the left-out notes and are not added.
